title: KNBS county livestock population, Kenya
source: KNBS National Agriculture Production Report (2023-24 + 2024-25 editions), livestock annexes
citation: KNBS. National Agriculture Production Report. Nairobi, Kenya.
license: KNBS official statistics — public; cite KNBS.
method: Deterministic extraction (_sources/napr_build_livestock.py + napr_annex.py), rebuilt 2026-10-15 (U2, _sources/napr_fix_2026-10-15.md). Column grid anchored on each annex page's printed Totals row; all printed county labels resolved (incl. broken-font Kilifi, 'T/Taveta'); no plausibility filtering. Gates: every column sums to the page's printed Totals row (all 39 species-years 100%); no unattributed rows; every value also present in pdfplumber's reading; county sum vs NAPR 2024 national tables T6.1-T6.4(b) per species-year in _sources/napr_livestock_gate.csv (38/39 within 1%; 2021 goats annex 33,681,560 vs T6.2 32,570,314 is a KNBS annex-vs-body difference, reported). Values are extension-officer estimates as printed by KNBS, not a census. No number typed by a model.
coverage: 13 species, head, 2021-2023, all 47 counties where printed (NAPR 2024 Annex 15-26, pp.129-140).
